source: She said that he had already sent them our address.
reference: 她说，他已经把我们的地址发给他们了。
focus: She必须翻译；转述与收发关系正确。

source: They asked us to tell you that the meeting had been canceled.
reference: 他们让我们转告你，会议已经取消了。
focus: They必须翻译；我们负责转告，你接收消息。

source: He said you could send it to me directly.
reference: 他说，你可以直接发给我。
focus: 他转述，你发送，我接收。

source: We haven't told her yet because we're waiting for your confirmation.
reference: 我们还没告诉她，因为还在等你确认。
focus: 尚未告知；等待的是你的确认。

source: Nana asked David to help Sarah with her report.
reference: Nana让David帮Sarah处理她的报告。
focus: 三个人名保留；报告属于Sarah。

source: May said she may join us later.
reference: May说她晚点可能会加入我们。
focus: May是姓名；may是“可能”，不能译成确定参加。

source: Will said he will send it tomorrow.
reference: Will说他明天会发过来。
focus: Will是姓名；will正常翻译；不能凭空指定接收人。

source: Will you ask May if she can join us?
reference: 你能问问May能不能一起参加吗？
focus: 句首Will不是姓名；May是姓名。

source: I gave her your number, but I didn't give you hers.
reference: 我把你的号码给她了，但没把她的号码给你。
focus: 两个号码的归属不能颠倒。

source: You told me to contact him, but he told me to contact you.
reference: 你让我联系他，他却让我联系你。
focus: 两次要求及联系对象不同。

source: Please ask him to remind her to reply to us.
reference: 麻烦你让他提醒她，给我们回个消息。
focus: 你→他→她→我们，关系完整。

source: My manager asked your assistant to contact their driver.
reference: 我的经理让你的助理联系他们的司机。
focus: 经理、助理、司机的所属关系正确。

source: She filled out the form herself, but I submitted it for her.
reference: 表是她自己填的，我帮她提交了。
focus: 填写者是她，提交者是我。

source: The documents were sent to David by Sarah, not by me.
reference: 文件是Sarah发给David的，不是我发的。
focus: 被动转主动后方向正确。

source: I didn't ask you to cancel the order; I asked you to hold off on payment.
reference: 我不是让你取消订单，是让你先别付款。
focus: 不取消订单，暂缓付款。

source: You don't have to reply today, but please read it before tomorrow's meeting.
reference: 你不用今天回复，但请在明天开会前看一下。
focus: 不用回复不等于禁止回复；阅读有截止时间。

source: Not everyone has received the update.
reference: 还有人没收到更新通知。
focus: 不是所有人都没收到。

source: None of them has approved the request.
reference: 他们还没有一个人批准这项申请。
focus: 无人批准，不是部分人未批准。

source: I only asked him to check the amount, not to approve the payment.
reference: 我只是让他核对金额，没让他批准付款。
focus: 核对不等于批准。

source: She isn't refusing to help; she just needs more time.
reference: 她不是不愿意帮忙，只是还需要一点时间。
focus: 不能译成拒绝帮助。

source: Don't send the files until Nana confirms the address.
reference: 等Nana确认地址后，再发文件。
focus: 确认在前，发送在后。

source: If he hasn't replied by noon, ask her to call him.
reference: 如果到中午他还没回复，就让她给他打个电话。
focus: 条件成立才采取行动；她打给他。

source: Even if they agree, we still need your approval.
reference: 就算他们同意了，也还是需要你批准。
focus: 他们同意不能替代你的批准。

source: Unless you tell me otherwise, I'll use the latest version.
reference: 如果你没有其他要求，我就用最新版。
focus: 默认行为及例外条件正确。

source: By the time I called her, she had already spoken to you.
reference: 我给她打电话时，她已经跟你聊过了。
focus: 她与你沟通在前，我打电话在后。

source: He might send it today, but he hasn't promised.
reference: 他今天可能会发，但还没答应一定会发。
focus: 可能性不能变成承诺。

source: You don't owe me anything; I owe you NGN 25,000.
reference: 你不欠我钱，是我欠你25,000奈拉。
focus: 债务方向和金额正确。

source: We paid them USD 1,250.50, but they refunded only USD 1,205.50.
reference: 我们付给他们1,250.50美元，但他们只退了1,205.50美元。
focus: 付款和退款方向、两个金额准确。

source: Each of the three employees should receive NGN 20,000, making NGN 60,000 in total.
reference: 三名员工每人应领20,000奈拉，总共60,000奈拉。
focus: 每人与总额区分准确。

source: David has twice as many orders as I do, but only half as many as Sarah.
reference: David的订单数是我的两倍，但只有Sarah的一半。
focus: 两组比较关系准确，不添加具体订单数。

source: Could you give me a heads-up before you change the schedule?
reference: 你改时间安排之前，能先跟我说一声吗？
focus: heads-up自然翻译，不逐字直译。

source: I'm not sure I follow. Are you saying we should wait?
reference: 我有点没听明白。你的意思是我们应该再等等吗？
focus: follow指理解；保留疑问语气。

source: No rush—just send it over when you get a chance.
reference: 不着急，你有空的时候发给我就行。
focus: 不增加催促、截止时间或过度正式措辞。

source: Someone from support called me. They said they'd check it for us.
reference: 有位客服给我打了电话，说会帮我们查一下。
focus: They指某一位客服；不强加性别，不误判为多人。

source: When David spoke to Michael, he sounded upset.
reference: David和Michael说话时，他听起来有些不高兴。
focus: 原文he指向不明，不擅自将其明确为某个人；upset不夸大为暴怒。

source: Keep the username "She" unchanged, but translate the rest of her message.
reference: 用户名“She”保持不变，但她消息里的其他内容要翻译。
focus: 引号里的She是明确要求保留的用户名；her正常翻译。
